questions.question: Which of the following minerals is NOT found in rivers (alluvial placers) and on the coast, especially beaches (beach placers)?

Why does the effective nuclear charge experienced by valence electrons decrease down the group?
questions.option_1: The outermost electrons are closest to the nucleus
questions.option_2: The outermost electrons are farther away from the nucleus
questions.option_3: The innermost electrons are farther away from the nucleus
